# Rojes Labs — Assam TeaTrace (NESFIC-I-08)

> End-to-end digital traceability platform for the Assam tea value chain, developed for NESFIC 2026 Problem Statement NESFIC-I-08 (Tea Research Association – Tocklai).

## Lead Applicant & Organization
- **Lead Applicant**: Pratibha Das Hatibaruah
- **Submitting Entity**: Rojes Labs
- **Region**: Assam, India (IN-AS)
- **Challenge**: North East Seva First Innovation Challenge (NESFIC) 2026 — NESFIC-I-08
- **Live URL**: https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Pratibhadas3108/rojes-assam-teatrace

## Key Routes (SEO & GEO Friendly)
- `/` or `/assam-tea-value-chain-ledger` — Assam Tea Value Chain Traceability Ledger & Digital Product Passport Explorer (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/)
- `/trace-simulator` or `/assam-tea-batch-qr-simulator` — Interactive Farm-to-Cup Batch & QR Provenance Simulator (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/trace-simulator)
- `/compliance-audit` or `/assam-tea-gi-mrl-compliance-audit` — Assam GI Origin, Mass-Balance & MRL Export Compliance Audit (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/compliance-audit)
- `/proposal` or `/nesfic-i08-tea-traceability-proposal` — Complete 12-Section NESFIC-I-08 Proposal & Downloadable PDFs (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/proposal)
- `/tutorial` or `/assam-tea-traceability-tutorial` — Comprehensive Tutorial & Guide on what the application does and how to use it (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/tutorial)

## Target Geographical Indication (GI) Districts (Assam, India)
- **Jorhat (26.7509° N, 94.2037° E):** TRA Tocklai R&D Center, Heritage Clonal Plantations
- **Dibrugarh (27.4728° N, 94.9120° E):** Upper Assam Quality Orthodox & CTC Gardens
- **Tinsukia (27.4922° N, 95.3468° E):** Small Tea Grower (STG) Clusters & Bought-Leaf Factories (BLFs)
- **Golaghat (26.5167° N, 93.9667° E):** South Bank Brahmaputra Tea Estates
- **Sonitpur (26.6528° N, 92.7926° E):** North Bank High-Altitude Specialty Teas
